title: 阿麥
subject: a woman in a Taipei studio flat who keeps a sourdough starter named 阿麥 alive, feeding it flour at seven every morning before work and taking the jar with her on the train when she visits a friend for the weekend
caption: Mandarin nu-jazz broken beat, West London style. Syncopated broken-beat drums with ghost-note snares, warm Fender Rhodes chords, walking upright bass, muted trumpet answering lines, soft synth pads. Dry close drums, soft tape saturation, warm low end. Female mezzo, intimate half-spoken verses, airy chorus. 104 BPM, E♭ minor. Calm, wry and quietly attentive. No trap beats, no EDM drop, no autotune, no rock guitar, no orchestral strings.
lyrics:
[Intro - broken-beat drums, Rhodes, muted trumpet]

[Verse 1]
七點鐘 鬧鐘還沒響
我先打開那個玻璃罐
一匙麵粉 一點溫水
阿麥冒了兩個泡

[Pre-Chorus]
它不會說話
但它會長高

[Chorus]
阿麥 阿麥 早安
今天也要吃飽
我去上班你在家
晚上看你多高

[Verse 2]
週末去台中找朋友
罐子放在背包最上面
火車晃了一路
我一直怕它溢出來

[Pre-Chorus]
朋友說妳帶了誰
我說一個室友

[Chorus]
阿麥 阿麥 到了
這裡的水不一樣
你在窗台上發脾氣
明天就帶你回家

[Outro - trumpet over Rhodes, drums thin out]
